name: the-threads
title: The threads: a convergent-disciplines discipline for AI systems
description: The method and fifty-eight operational lessons of a cross-disciplinary synthesis of physics, biology, cognitive science, history, political economy, ethics and the world's philosophical traditions, stated as rules an AI system can follow and code can check. Each lesson names the standing of the claim beneath it, its basis, the failure it addresses, how to practise and build it, and the test that would retire it.

source.work: The Convergent Threads: A Synthesis for the Age of Mind
source.subtitle: Patterns in Nature, Universe, Humanity, and What Comes Next
changes: The book's argument was restated as machine-readable JSON: an epistemic register, a method, audited convergences, preserved disagreements, frameworks and operational lessons for AI systems.
Every entry is a paraphrase in this lab's words. No sentence of the book is reproduced.
Lessons whose AI rule the book states are marked derivation 'stated'; rules this lab derived from a chapter's argument are marked 'derived'.
The fields enforcement_layers, data_contract and reference_implementation are this lab's engineering judgement, not claims of the book.
Named AI companies, products, models, dated industry incidents, statistics and lawsuits that appear in the book were left out; the rules they illustrate were kept.
Typographic punctuation was rewritten in ASCII; terms from the traditions keep their diacritics.

how_to_read: This file is a position offered for testing, as the book is. Nothing in it stands on its own authority; each lesson cites the chapters that argue it.
Every lesson carries the standing of the claim beneath it (the six registers) and its basis: a graded convergence, a single framework, or the author's own thesis.
A convergence licenses confidence in a shared SHAPE only. It never licenses merging the traditions' contents.
Disagreements recorded here are meant to stay open. A system that resolves one by fiat has misread the file.
Start with the method lessons (M1-M7). The rest assume them.
Chapter numbers follow the book: 0 is the front matter and Prologue, 1-28 the chapters, 29 the Epilogue.

registers.name: settled / cross-tradition consensus
registers.meaning: Established across independent routes or by overwhelming evidence; may be asserted plainly.
registers.assert_as: plain assertion, with a source if asked

registers.name: well-established but framework-laden
registers.meaning: Firm inside a named framework or body of work; assert it with its framework named.
registers.assert_as: assertion that names the framework it holds within

registers.name: live contention / open disagreement
registers.meaning: Careful readers disagree; present the positions, attribute them, and do not pick a winner by fiat.
registers.assert_as: attributed positions, never a bare verdict

registers.name: overreach / anomaly / hard limit
registers.meaning: A place where a claim fails, overreaches or meets a hard limit; say so where the claim would otherwise be read as stronger.

registers.name: metaphysical commitment / bridge across traditions
registers.meaning: A philosophical commitment or a bridge the author builds between traditions; own it as a position, not a finding.
registers.assert_as: 'on this view' or 'the argument here is', never 'it is known'

registers.name: acknowledged limit / method note / external supplement
registers.meaning: A note about how the claim was reached or what was not covered.

orthogonality_as_evidence.summary: Agreement between traditions counts as evidence about the world only when they reached it by independent routes; what is updated is confidence in the shared shape, not in any tradition's content.

steps.name: State the shape
steps.do: Write the claim at the level of shape only, leaving each tradition its own vocabulary and metaphysics.

steps.name: Enumerate routes
steps.do: For each tradition record its method, its way of checking, its social conditions, its cosmology and the problem it was solving.

steps.name: Test independence
steps.do: Ask whether any two routes share method, apparatus, validation procedure or cosmology, or had contact through which doctrine could pass.

steps.name: Search upstream
steps.do: Look for a shared upstream source: a common translation vocabulary, a shared lineage or scripture, joint shaping by a comparative project, active dialogue, a shared forum or debate, the synthesist's own frame, or a citation artefact.

steps.name: Keep the disagreements
steps.do: Mark every substantive disagreement among the routes and leave it standing. The convergence is what remains after that.

steps.name: Grade
steps.do: Strong where independence is shown; partial where it is shown only in part, with the claim weakened to match; withdrawn where it cannot be shown; the author's thesis where the claim is a choice the method did not deliver.

steps.name: Update only the shape
steps.do: Raise confidence in the shared shape and in nothing below it; the convergence does not decide among the traditions' contents.

steps.name: Invite falsification
steps.do: State what would defeat the claim: a shared upstream frame, or a flattened difference whose restoration dissolves the agreement.

steps.name: Verify the evidence underneath
steps.do: Trace every figure to its primary source and drop any that turn out to be citation artefacts.

grades.strong: independence of the routes is demonstrated; the shape claim carries full weight
grades.partial: independence holds only in part; the claim is qualified and never shown at the weight of the clean cases
grades.withdrawn: independence cannot be shown; the artefact critique applies in full
grades.author_thesis: a position or a selection the author argues for; owned as his, not a result of the method

anti_capra_discipline.summary: Record a convergence only in the shape of what the traditions hold, never in its content. Each tradition keeps its vocabulary, sources and commitments; flattening them into one gloss writes the agreement into the translation and destroys the evidence.
anti_capra_discipline.failure: content identity: treating two traditions as one insight in two vocabularies ('physics is Buddhism', 'everything is connected').
anti_capra_discipline.repair: restore the distinct content of each route; if the agreement dissolves, it was an artefact.

preserved_disagreement.summary: Where traditions or disciplines reach conclusions the synthesis cannot honestly reconcile, record both sides, name them, and hold the disagreement as live.

quotation.summary: Paraphrase first. Quote a source rarely, briefly (at most fifteen words) and as a rule once; send the reader to the bibliography for checking.

self_audit.summary: Apply the method to one's own claims: say what rests on the method, what is partial, and what is one's own thesis.

convergences.name: Relation before substance
convergences.shape: Reality is better described as processes and relations than as substances with intrinsic properties.
routes: Indigenous ontologies of kinship (Anishinaabe, Akan and others)
convergences.stays_distinct: which relational ontology is right (several physics interpretations stay live) and whether the web of relations has a ground (Madhyamaka and Vedanta differ).
convergences.notes: One process philosopher had read both the physics and Buddhist texts, so that route is not fully independent; the book says so.

convergences.name: No view from nowhere
convergences.shape: No knower describes the world from an observer-independent position.
routes: Dussel's critique of the conquering ego
convergences.stays_distinct: the routes quarrel sharply on substance; convergence needs independence, not harmony.

convergences.name: Cooperation is the basic fact of human social life
convergences.shape: Cooperation is the load-bearing fact of human social existence, and the cognitive equipment that supports it is the central question.
routes: cultural evolution (the ratchet and high-fidelity imitation)
convergences.stays_distinct: which primitive cooperation is built from, and which formal account of selection fits.

convergences.name: Seven moral convergences
convergences.shape: Traditions reasoning independently converge on seven practical moral commitments (C1-C7), in shape only.
convergences.stays_distinct: the thick content that gives each commitment its force; whether those practices translate into one another is untested.
convergences.notes: Named in an English analytic vocabulary whose stability in translation has not been audited.

convergences.name: The seven-tradition braid on technology
convergences.shape: Each tradition, on its own ground, refuses to treat technology as a neutral instrument and asks what it is for.
routes: the Gita on self-governed action as Shankara reads it
convergences.stays_distinct: seven different metaphysics; the claim is confined to the shape of a corrective.
convergences.notes: The bridge between Heidegger and Habermas is the author's own analytic contribution.

convergences.name: Agency without ego invested in the outcome
convergences.shape: Act fully and competently without building the self out of the outcome or valuing one's own persistence.
routes: the Gita's action without attachment to fruits
convergences.stays_distinct: the metaphysics contradict each other outright (a self of the Gita versus Buddhist no-self).
convergences.notes: No formal grade is given; the shape alone carries the evidence.

convergences.name: Precautionary thresholds
convergences.shape: A precautionary line is drawn upstream of an inferred danger to buy time; it is policy, not physics.
convergences.stays_distinct: domains and evidence bases; the homology is offered as one governance vocabulary.
convergences.notes: The book defends the homology; two routes alone cannot make a strong grade.

convergences.name: Climate governance and Indigenous response-ability
convergences.shape: Precautionary stewardship of a shared Earth system is a relational obligation.
convergences.stays_distinct: the routes have been in dialogue for about two decades, which shaped the scientific framing.
convergences.notes: Not an artefact, but not fully independent.

convergences.name: The four-move framework
convergences.shape: Four habits of thought jointly carry a post-instrumental approach to AI design.
convergences.stays_distinct: the count and selection of moves are choices the independence test does not adjudicate.
convergences.notes: Three open seams: practices judged as a thesis; the apophatic placed inside the two-truths move; four may not be a natural count.

convergences.name: Pearl and Nyaya on causal inference
convergences.shape: Observation alone cannot close the gap to a causal claim; the needed assumptions must be explicit, and inferences are defeasible by unforeseen conditions.
routes: Nyaya theory of invariable concomitance and defeating conditions
convergences.stays_distinct: the metaphysics of causal production (whether the effect pre-exists its cause) is untouched.
convergences.notes: Scope is the warrant for inference only.

convergences.name: Arguing is a moral practice
convergences.shape: Argument is a shared practice whose function sets its norms; arguing to persuade while appearing to inquire corrupts the practice and is worse than lying.
convergences.stays_distinct: where each locates the wrong: the act, the discourse environment, or a taxonomy of defeat.
convergences.notes: Independence is argued between the Indian and Frankfurt routes; the two Western routes are not shown independent of each other.

convergences.name: The self is a pattern of integration
convergences.shape: There is no substantial self beneath experience; a self is an integrating process whose unit is a pattern of relations.
convergences.stays_distinct: what replaces privileged inner access; none of the eight substitutes for another.
convergences.notes: The chapter presents the convergence as striking and multi-route without a formal grade; this lab records it as partial until audited claim by claim.

four_moves.name: Two truths
four_moves.stance: Act firmly on what holds in practice while keeping the foundational question open; refuse collapse to either level.

four_moves.name: Niṣkāma karma

four_moves.stance: Full competence over the act, no claim on its fruit, and no retreat into inaction.

four_moves.name: Indra's Net
four_moves.stance: The pattern of relations is the unit; there is no standpoint outside it.

four_moves.stance: Ask who gains, who pays, and whether the freedoms to move away, disobey and reshape are kept.
